prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A few Joplin-area options worth getting quotes from:

- **American Construction Inc.** — listed by the BBB as serving Joplin and surrounding areas, with an **A+ rating**. **417-781-6811**. [BBB listing](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/general-contractor)
- **GRC General Construction** — listed for remodeling and general contracting, with an **A+ BBB rating**. **417-499-7424**. [BBB listing](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/home-improvement)
- **Roof Master’s Remodeling Inc.** — listed for remodeling and home improvement, with an **A+ BBB rating**. **417-726-5226**. [BBB listing](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/home-repair)

BBB ratings are a useful starting point, not a guarantee of workmanship. For a larger remodel, I’d get at least three written bids, ask for recent local references and proof of insurance, and make sure the contract spells out scope, materials, payment schedule, and change orders. For a small repair, ask whether the contractor handles that specific trade.
